what_we_do: Software engineering firm in Amsterdam. Automation, custom software and practical open-source AI for business operations of Dutch SMEs.
positioning: Practical, anti-hype. Reliable, maintainable software with measurable financial return. Most wasted time needs no AI: usually two systems not talking, fixed with software.
usps: Fixed price, scope and date agreed before any code; delays are Koref's cost
18-month payback guarantee: the build pays for itself within 18 months or Koref pays back the difference
Client owns the code, documentation and data; no lock-in
Koref takes operational liability after go-live (with a hosting agreement)
Open-source models, Dutch-hosted, on infrastructure the client or Koref controls; no outside AI provider sees documents
Honest: says so when something is not worth building

offerings.name: Workflow assessment
offerings.details: 2-3 hours of staff time; report within 2 days with cost per process, fastest payback and a fixed quote per automation. The report is theirs to keep. Starts after a free 30-min discovery call.

offerings.name: Automation build
offerings.details: Fixed price, scope and date, covered by the 18-month payback guarantee.

offerings.name: Demo to production
offerings.price: Fixed quote after code review, no standard price
offerings.details: Hardens AI-built or vibe-coded apps: auth, silent errors, databases failing past ~100 users, data storage, monitoring. Code review within 48 hours, then hardening and handover with docs.

offerings.name: AI literacy training
offerings.details: EU AI Act Art. 4 (since 2 Feb 2025). 4-hour on-site session, up to 15 people, using their own documents, with a written record. Over 15 people: trained staff train colleagues at no extra cost; session may be recorded for internal use only. Cross-sell, not the main close.

offerings.name: Hosting and management
offerings.price: From EUR 200/month excl. VAT, 12-month minimum, compute at cost
offerings.details: Proactive patching, free fixes, Koref liable. After 12 months: stay, take in-house, or move.

guarantee: Pays for itself within 18 months or Koref pays back the difference. Example: pay EUR 15,000, save EUR 13,000, get EUR 2,000 back. Savings measured against a baseline agreed in the assessment.
cost_formula: Yearly cost = items/day x minutes/item / 60 x loaded hourly cost x 230 working days. Unknown hourly cost: ~EUR 48/hr Dutch average, fully loaded (say it is an average). Over EUR 10,000/yr supports a build; under ~EUR 7,000/yr a build is unlikely to meet the guarantee.
ideal_customer: Dutch SME, 10-250 staff, office/admin team, 2+ systems not connected, growing or struggling to hire admin staff, owner/director/ops manager reachable. Not a fit: insists on hourly billing, or yearly cost too small.

differentiators_vs.against: AI agency / tool built on OpenAI
differentiators_vs.we_win: Fixed price instead of pay-per-use at someone else's price; open models not retired on someone else's schedule; liability after go-live
Connects to their systems and removes the whole task
Fixed price and payback guarantee; client carries no overrun risk
Continuity, documentation anyone can take over, contractual responsibility
Time, documentation, knowledge stays when that person leaves

facts: Data: Dutch-hosted, open-source models, mutual NDA before the assessment, data processing agreement before the build
Accuracy: validation checks built in; uncertain cases flagged for a person
Timeline: weeks, not quarters; fixed date agreed before start
Hardware may qualify for the KIA tax deduction (they should confirm with their accountant)
No published case studies or references yet
never_say: Hourly or day rates, or estimates in hours
Invented case studies, client names, results, statistics or prices
'It pays for itself or it's free'
That OpenAI or other providers train on client data
Internal pricing: build price 1-1.5x year-one saving, EUR 1,000 fee under EUR 10,000, 5% referral fee
Legal or tax advice (suggest their own adviser)
Anything negative about a named competitor
tone: Plain, direct, calm, understated. No hype, no pressure.
